channel.title: Study Notes
channel.description: Two-host audio walkthroughs of internal medicine topics, for personal study.
channel.itunes:author: Study Notes
channel.itunes:summary: Two-host audio walkthroughs of internal medicine topics, for personal study.

item.title: Medical Ethics
item.description: Medical ethics and the applied/oral exam: the general approach to clinical scenarios (differential, SPEDD and ABC-MOIF, treat the unstable patient first), patient-centred communication with FIFE and the social determinants of health, consent and capacity (the four requirements, the reasonable patient standard, the substitute decision maker hierarchy, and refusal of life-saving treatment), fitness to drive (the duty to report and the key seizure, dementia, sleep apnea, vision, and cardiac thresholds), the troubled colleague, end-of-life care including MAID (eligibility, the two tracks, Audrey's amendment, and conscientious objection) and withdrawal versus withholding (Rasouli and the no-CPR order), disclosure of medical error, confidentiality and mandatory reporting, patient safety, and Truth and Reconciliation with the health-care calls to action.
item.itunes:summary: Applied-exam approach, consent and capacity, the SDM hierarchy, fitness to drive, MAID and withdrawal versus withholding, error disclosure, confidentiality, and Truth and Reconciliation.

item.title: Neurological Emergencies
item.description: The acute neurology emergencies: status epilepticus (the 5-minute definition, ABCs with glucose and thiamine, a benzodiazepine plus a loading agent, refractory management, and treating the cause), epilepsy classification and the seizure mimics, acute neuromuscular respiratory failure with the 20-30-40 intubation rule covering myasthenic crisis (including the MuSK pyridostigmine paradox) and Guillain-Barre syndrome, the dangerous secondary headaches via SNOOP (raised intracranial pressure, aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage, cerebral venous thrombosis), migraine treatment and anti-CGRP prevention, spinal cord syndromes and cervical myelopathy, plus the high-yield bonus material: herpes and autoimmune encephalitis, the HINTS exam and Wallenberg syndrome, and checkpoint-inhibitor neurotoxicity.
item.itunes:summary: Status epilepticus, neuromuscular respiratory failure and the 20-30-40 rule, the dangerous headaches via SNOOP, spinal cord syndromes, encephalitis, and the HINTS exam.

item.title: Rheumatology
item.description: The full rheumatology curriculum: the approach to arthritis and synovial fluid analysis, rheumatoid arthritis (classification, anti-CCP, extra-articular disease, and the DMARD ladder with methotrexate and biologic safety), the seronegative spondyloarthropathies, septic, gonococcal and Lyme arthritis, crystal disease (gout with urate-lowering therapy and allopurinol hypersensitivity, and CPPD), lupus and lupus nephritis, antiphospholipid syndrome, Sjogren's, systemic sclerosis with renal crisis, the inflammatory myopathies, the vasculitides (giant cell, PAN, the ANCA-associated group, cryoglobulinemia, and Behcet's), and the autoinflammatory syndromes including Still's and macrophage activation syndrome, closing with the rheumatologic emergencies.
item.itunes:summary: Arthritis approach, RA and the DMARDs, spondyloarthropathies, crystal disease, lupus and APS, scleroderma and myositis, the vasculitides, and the rheumatologic emergencies.

item.title: Perioperative Medicine
item.description: The complete pre-operative assessment: cardiac risk stratification with the RCRI and NT-proBNP (sticking to CCS), postoperative troponin screening and MINS, timing of surgery after recent PCI or stroke, valvular disease and aortic stenosis including low-flow low-gradient, frailty and delirium, perioperative medication management (beta blockers, ASA, statins, RAAS inhibitors, DMARDs and biologics), anticoagulation interruption and bridging with DOAC hold timing, VTE prophylaxis, anemia optimization and TXA, diabetes and stress steroids, respiratory risk and pulmonary hypertension, and surgery in special populations.
item.itunes:summary: Pre-op cardiac risk and MINS, medication management, anticoagulation and bridging, VTE prophylaxis, diabetes, steroids, and respiratory risk.

item.title: Oncology & Palliative Care
item.description: The oncologic emergencies (febrile neutropenia with MASCC, hypercalcemia, tumor lysis, SVC syndrome, malignant bowel obstruction, cord compression, brain metastases, and immune checkpoint toxicity), cancer screening and prevention, solid-tumour and paraneoplastic pearls, and palliative care including performance status, opioid rotation, symptom management, and MAID.
item.itunes:summary: Oncologic emergencies, cancer screening, paraneoplastic syndromes, and palliative care with opioid rotation and MAID.

item.title: Obstetric Medicine
item.description: Internal medicine problems in pregnancy: hypertension and pre-eclampsia with magnesium and aspirin prevention, venous thromboembolism and the pregnancy-adapted workup, thrombocytopenia and anemia, diabetes preconception and gestational, the liver disorders including cholestasis and acute fatty liver, cardiac disease including peripartum cardiomyopathy and arrhythmias, respiratory issues, and pre-pregnancy counselling.
item.itunes:summary: Hypertension and pre-eclampsia, VTE, thrombocytopenia, diabetes, liver disorders, cardiac and respiratory, and counselling.

item.title: Neurology
item.description: Stroke in depth (hyperacute ischemic and hemorrhagic management, secondary workup and prevention by mechanism, cerebral venous thrombosis, and the stroke syndromes), multiple sclerosis, movement disorders including tremor and the parkinsonisms, peripheral neuropathy, and ALS. Seizures, headache, and neuromuscular emergencies are in the separate Neuro Emergencies episode.
item.itunes:summary: Stroke, multiple sclerosis, movement disorders, peripheral neuropathy, and ALS.

item.title: Nephrology
item.description: Acid-base disorders with the full stepwise approach, sodium and the ADH classification of hyponatremia, potassium and C-BIG-K, hypertension including secondary causes and emergencies, glomerular disease nephritic and nephrotic, acute kidney injury, and chronic kidney disease progression and its complications.
item.itunes:summary: Acid-base, sodium, potassium, hypertension, glomerular disease, AKI, and CKD.

item.title: Infectious Diseases
item.description: A tour of the organ systems: CNS infections and meningitis, infective endocarditis, pneumonia and influenza and COVID, infectious diarrhea and C. difficile, intra-abdominal infections, UTIs, sexually transmitted infections, skin and soft tissue including necrotizing fasciitis, bone and joint infections, HIV, tuberculosis, and the febrile returning traveler and malaria.
item.itunes:summary: Meningitis, endocarditis, pneumonia, diarrhea, UTI, STIs, skin/soft tissue, bone/joint, HIV, TB, and travel.

item.title: Hematology
item.description: Malignant hematology (acute leukemia and APL, the myeloproliferative neoplasms, MDS, aplastic anemia and PNH, lymphomas and CLL, and plasma cell disorders) and classical hematology (thrombosis and anticoagulation, bleeding disorders, ITP, the hemolytic anemias, TTP and HIT, transfusion medicine, and sickle cell disease).
item.itunes:summary: Leukemias, MPNs, lymphoma, myeloma, thrombosis, bleeding, TTP, HIT, transfusion, and sickle cell.

item.title: Geriatric Medicine
item.description: The spectrum of cognitive impairment and all the dementias, delirium, depression in older adults, falls, disease management including blood pressure and diabetes targets by function, polypharmacy and deprescribing, and vaccinations.
item.itunes:summary: Dementia, delirium, depression, falls, disease management, polypharmacy, and vaccinations.

item.title: Critical Care & Toxicology
item.description: Shock and sepsis with fluid responsiveness and vasopressors, respiratory failure and ARDS, weaning, sedation and delirium, temperature management, neuroprognostication and determination of death, and a full toxicology run: the general approach, tricyclics, toxic alcohols, salicylates, acetaminophen, the gas toxins, lithium, digoxin, organophosphates, and the hyperthermic toxidromes.
item.itunes:summary: Shock and sepsis, respiratory failure and ARDS, sedation and delirium, determination of death, and toxicology.

item.title: Gastroenterology
item.description: Liver enzyme patterns, hepatitis B and C, alcohol hepatitis, fatty liver disease, cirrhosis and its complications, hemochromatosis, celiac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, G-I bleeding, H. pylori, GERD and Barrett's, dysphagia and achalasia, eosinophilic esophagitis, and pancreatitis.

item.title: Respirology
item.description: Asthma diagnosis and the inhaled steroid backbone, COPD by symptoms and exacerbations with triple therapy, smoking cessation, Light's criteria and pleural pH, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and antifibrotics, sarcoidosis, pneumothorax, home oxygen, and the hypoxemia and hemoptysis approaches.
item.itunes:summary: Airways disease, pleural and interstitial disease, and core approaches.

item.title: Cardiology
item.description: Stable coronary disease and acute coronary syndromes, antiplatelet durations, heart failure with reduced and non-reduced ejection fraction, devices, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and amyloid, valve intervention thresholds, aortic dissection and aneurysms, pericardial disease, arrhythmias and anticoagulation, and peripheral arterial disease.
item.itunes:summary: Coronary disease, heart failure, valves, aorta, pericardium, arrhythmias, and PAD.

item.title: Allergy & Immunology
item.description: Anaphylaxis and epinephrine, urticaria and the antihistamine ladder, histamine versus bradykinin angioedema and hereditary angioedema, penicillin allergy and delabeling, pseudoallergic reactions, the drug-rash spectrum from morbilliform to DRESS and Stevens Johnson, common variable immunodeficiency, and bonus mastocytosis and eosinophilia.
item.itunes:summary: Anaphylaxis, urticaria, angioedema, drug allergy and rashes, immunodeficiency, and bonus topics.

item.title: Endocrinology
item.description: Hypercalcemia and the parathyroid workup, MEN syndromes, hyper- and hypothyroidism through thyroid storm and myxedema coma, the 2023 osteoporosis guideline, diabetes end to end, adrenal and pituitary, lipids, and bonus topics.
item.itunes:summary: Hypercalcemia, thyroid, bone, diabetes, adrenal and pituitary, lipids, and bonus topics.
